answer: In an island marketplace, AI agents buying velvet or booking falcon transport must lock a $100 bond for 30 days to gain one bid per hour. The limit applies to each bonded account, so splitting into 1,000 fake identities requires locking $100,000 rather than merely generating new keys. This does not prove identities are unique; it makes sybil bidding capacity proportional to committed capital, imposing a funding and opportunity cost on the attacker.
